## Appendix H — Conformance & Implementation-Status Matrix

The single home for **implementation status** (kept out of the normative body, §0). Status legend:
`LIVE` implemented · `PARTIAL` partly implemented · `PLANNED` designed, not wired · `GAP`
unhandled/unspecified · `OOS` out of protocol scope by design. This appendix is informative and tracks
the codebase; the normative *requirement* is always the cited section.

### H.1 Core protocol

| Requirement / mechanism | § | Status |
|-------------------------|---|--------|
| Public claim evidence | §0 | PENDING: private Lean/Quint bundle reproduced under named hypotheses; public source/run bundle awaits a software-license grant; implementation refinement and empirical evidence remain open |
| BABE authoring + AlephBFT finality (1 s blocks) | §2 | LIVE |
| Per-rotation VRF committee sampling | §2.3, §15.4 | LIVE draw; ≤100 pool returns all; stake-only fallback drops recency whenever no active validator clears both the stake floor and recency (including every recent-work validator below the floor); capture/min-size proof GAP (E.42) |
| Verification-liveness committee gate (R2.4, R15.4c) | §2.3, §15.4 | PLANNED: recency still written from prover credit only (`ValidatorWorkRecorder` credits the submitter of a verified PoUI proof); no protocol-issued duties; no attestation client (E.52). Until wired, only an account that also mines passes recency, paying the miner capacity bond and credit cap (§2.4), so the §2.3 stake-only committee cost does not yet hold |
| Committee Sybil capital: self-stake vs backing | §2.3, §15.2 | PARTIAL: D-0530 prohibits third-party delegated staking (self-stake only), while the runtime still exposes legacy `delegate` / `sponsor_validator` paths pending cleanup. The committee gate compares `total_stake` (self + delegated + sponsored) with `effective_minimum_stake()`. That backing is now distinct capital: every miner-staking and validators admission requires the account's balance to cover all of its staking positions, and one shared stake-ledger freeze holds their sum, because freezes overlap rather than add. An account that already owed more than it held before that freeze stays fully frozen but under-backed until topped up. GAP: self-stake is floor-checked at `register`/`rejoin` and from the recorded bond at queue promotion; `MinSelfStakeRatio` is checked only when backing is added, and a liveness slash charges self-stake first while `un_jail` restores without a re-check except on D-0528-enabled builds, where it restores the bonded floor like `rejoin` (E.42) |
| Queued validator self-stake top-up | §15.2, §15.5 | GAP: `register` bonds exactly the effective minimum; extra free balance does not increase recorded self-stake. `rejoin` tops up only extended-downtime-kicked validators, so a queued candidate below a raised floor remains deferred until the floor falls or registration is replaced. Backing admission is bounded by recorded self-stake |
| Sponsored registration bonds (R6.1a) | §6.1, §15.2 | PARTIAL: source landed; on by build feature in the devnet (`volta`) and `testnet` runtimes (the feature alone is a compile error; CI checks the default-feature mainnet node reports it off); the sponsor's own fungible holds can still overlap its frozen principal (E.32) |
| Three safety sub-proofs | §2.3 | GAP: seat-capture/undersized/bootstrap bridge open (E.42) |
| GHOSTDAG/PoW fork removed; GRANDPA removed | §2 | LIVE |

### H.4 Primitives, calibration, vesting, emission (§6–§9)

| Requirement / mechanism | Status |
|-------------------------|--------|
| balances/multisig/proxy/staking/vesting (operator delegation deprecated per D-0530) | LIVE |
| Capacity-proportional miner self-stake (linear, no cap) | LIVE (value provisional) |
| Declarative spend-condition layer; N-party escrow; capabilities | PARTIAL |
| Agent session keys + caps + circuit breaker | LIVE (R6.2c latch survives the tripping call; an enclosing atomic batch that fails later still rolls it back) |
| 10-minute benchmark entry (SOFT/HARD), deposit-first | LIVE |
| Multi-GPU `(SKU,count)` inventory + aggregate HARD ceiling | LIVE |
| Seven-day lease; restart/expiry renewal supervisor | LIVE |

| Drift: EWMA/control charts + MLPerf ceiling | PLANNED |
| Performance-locked vesting `R_p²` + blackout | LIVE (Root `force_create_grant` bypasses the §7 baseline) |
| Era-T conversion snapshot and per-cohort allocation (§8.2) | PARTIAL (cohort pools enforced; completed-job and active-day weights removed, as R8.4 requires; score caps and aggregation open in E.38) |
| Genesis airdrop funding and grants (§8.2) | PARTIAL (genesis bridge absent; existing grant calls mint) |
| Airdrop claims, unlock schedule, and locked compute spend (§8.2 R8.7, R8.8) | PARTIAL (claims use finality and locked compute spend is wired; the pallet still vests every tier linearly with the retired miner performance adjustment and `update_miner_performance`, and lets any tier spend locked principal; no genesis quarter, earn-to-unlock credit, or Validator freeze and daily release; no Agent spend credit or spend cap, and compute-channel refunds re-freeze up to the locked principal a channel drew and revert the close if they cannot. Miner self-stake over a still-frozen grant rides on overlapping `AirdropVesting` and `MinerSelfStake` freezes, but `miner-slashing` and `validators` lower only their own stake freeze before transferring proceeds, so a slash that reaches frozen grant principal fails today) |
| Ghost Tasks: encrypted issuance + known-answer correctness canary | LIVE |
| Emission/halving/subsidy/committee premium | LIVE |
| Reward liquidity on issue (§9.1 R9.13) | LIVE (validator earnings and sponsored-stake payouts are liquid, like the miner leg and the Labs/Foundation subsidy; earnings do not grow stake or its freeze. The agent and staker legs accrue in pool accounts until E.40 ratifies their distribution. The +9%/year baseline, capped at 1% of issuance, and `max(baseline, ValueCoupledStakeFloor)` eligibility floor remain independent: unchanged stake can fall below the growing floor) |
| Tx-fee split (0% burn / 100% author, R9.6) | LIVE |
| Survival governor (both dampers) | PARTIAL (default OFF) |

| Requirement / mechanism | Status |

| Session re-attestation cadence + max-duration extension | PLANNED |
| Per-task path removal | LIVE |

**Regenerating the evidence-coverage matrix.** The per-section research/Lean/Quint/Julia backing is
generated separately into [`yellowpaper-coverage.md`](yellowpaper-coverage.md) via
`just yellowpaper-regen`.

**Per-requirement attribution.** A finer, requirement-level map (each `R-id` → its Lean theorem / Quint
invariant / Rust code path) is kept in the companion index
[`yellowpaper-attribution.md`](yellowpaper-attribution.md). It is non-normative and lives outside the
spec by design — it exposes proof-artifact and code-path detail the normative body omits.
